title: tpu-roofline Result
description: Output payload of the tpu-roofline agent. Every number it carries is modelled, not measured. The full report stays on disk; this payload carries the summary and the paths.

status.description: 'completed': a roofline was computed. 'needs_input': a required choice is missing and is listed in `missing`. 'invalid_input': the request names nothing to model. 'failed': the selftest or a script failed.

summary.description: Short result: the headline numbers, what binds them, and what would have to change to move them.

provenance.description: Provenance label of every number in this result.

results.description: Optional headline numbers, keyed by metric name (for example roofline_ms, bound_by, t_prefill_ms, tpot_ms). Keys are not fixed.

missing.description: Inputs required before a roofline can be computed, when status is 'needs_input'.

artifacts.description: Paths of the files written: the report, the config, the raw output and the CSV.

error_message.description: Diagnostic message when status is 'failed' or 'invalid_input'.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.summary: MoE down-projection, 8192 tokens: roofline 1.42 ms, HBM bound. Weight reads are 81% of the bytes.
Cannot compute the model roofline: the workload is not given.

missing.reason: ISL, OSL, max-num-batched-tokens and decode concurrency set every phase time.
